title: Guide authors toward complete traceability
statement: As a human or AI author, I can discover the Saga grammar, see the highest-value unresolved gaps, and safely advance the artifact until every required intent-to-diff path is reviewable.

acceptance_criteria.statement: change-saga spec --json enumerates supported resource kinds, relationships, mutations, invariants, and required arguments rather than only legacy storage shapes.
change-saga status --json returns ordered actionable gaps with the affected story or criterion, the reason, and a valid command shape when the next step is deterministic.
When the next step requires product judgment, credentials, external evidence, or an explicit exclusion, the result tells the AI what focused question to ask instead of inventing an answer.
Suggested mutations use stable IDs, explicit current parents, request IDs, validation, and atomic writes so retries and concurrent authors preserve history.
The authoring loop repeats inspect, ask or mutate, validate, and re-evaluate until no required current coverage gap remains.
A complete graph proves traceability and omission coverage, not that the design, code, or tests are correct.
